packageRules.description: Majors open as drafts with no automerge: a draft is not reviewed, so they come to the Kernel Coordinator, who marks them ready.
Updates to files under .github/ (workflow and action pins, reusable shared-web workflows) can touch reviewer paths: drafts with no automerge, so they come to the Kernel Coordinator.
wasix-python and its py-* extension packages are built against one CPython: they bump together, in one PR, so a new numpy never meets the old python (#1180, #1181).
